# Zechariah Chapter 14 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A) | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ZEC_014_page_001.jpg

---

## Consensus Translation

**14:8** And-it-will-be [vehayah] in-that day [ba-yom ha-hu], living [chayyim] waters [mayim] will-go-out [yetse'u] from-Yerushalayim — half [chetsyam] to-the-eastern [ha-qadmoni] sea [ha-yam] and-half to-the-western [ha-acharon] sea; in-summer [ba-qayits] and-in-winter [u-va-choref] it-will-be.

**14:9** And-YHWH will-be [vehayah] king [le-melekh] over all the-earth [kol ha-arets]; in-that day YHWH will-be one [echad] and-his-name one [echad].

---
## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Zechariah 14 — part of the Book of the Twelve (Minor Prophets).
